name: @devdigest/agent-runner
description: DevDigest CI runner: bundles reviewer-core and the shared contracts into a self-contained script (dist/index.js) that the server exports into a target repo as .devdigest/runner/ and the repo's own GitHub Actions run. Consumes reviewer-core and @devdigest/shared as raw TypeScript source through tsconfig path aliases, exactly like the server.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ncc build src/index.ts -o dist
